units.source_text: 又有人提出“厌世自杀”说。

en.t: Someone else advanced the theory of world-weary suicide.

units.source_text: 提出这个说法的是那男人的一个同事，一个热衷于精神分析的人。

en.t: The person who put forward this theory was one of the man's colleagues, someone devoted to psychoanalysis.

units.source_text: 据他介绍说，已经成了堂堂的大男人，

en.t: According to him, although the man had already become a full-grown adult,

units.source_text: 却还热衷于收集昆虫标本之类的东西，

en.t: he was still absorbed in things like collecting insect specimens,

units.source_text: 本身已经可以证明他精神上存在着某种缺陷。

en.t: and that in itself was enough to prove that he had some kind of mental defect.

units.source_text: 即使是个孩子，在采集昆虫标本方面表现出异常的嗜好，

en.t: Even when a child shows an abnormal fondness for collecting insect specimens,

units.source_text: 也大多被人看作有“恋母情结”，

en.t: people usually regard it as a sign of a mother complex,

units.source_text: 他们明知昆虫尸体决不会逃走，

en.t: for they know perfectly well that dead insects will never run away,

units.source_text: 却还是用大头针紧紧地固定住那些尸体，

en.t: yet they still pin those corpses down tightly with large pins,

units.source_text: 以此来发泄自己无法满足的欲望。

en.t: using this act to release desires they cannot satisfy.

units.source_text: 要是成了大人以后，还戒不掉那种嗜好，

en.t: If, after becoming an adult, he still cannot give up that obsession,

units.source_text: 可见病症是在一天天地加重。

en.t: then it is clear that the illness is growing worse day by day.

units.source_text: 昆虫采集专家，往往是个占有欲旺盛的人，

en.t: An insect-collecting specialist is often a person with a strong desire to possess,

units.source_text: 一个极端排他的人，有小偷小摸行为的人，

en.t: someone extremely exclusionary, someone given to petty theft,

units.source_text: 甚至是个同性恋者，决不是偶然。

en.t: and even a homosexual; this is by no means accidental.

units.source_text: 距离“厌世自杀”不过只有一步之遥。

en.t: It is only one step away from world-weary suicide.

units.source_text: 眼下，也许杀虫瓶里的氰化钾比采集活动本身更吸引那些昆虫收集爱好者，

en.t: At present, perhaps the potassium cyanide in the killing jar attracts those insect collectors more than the act of collecting itself,

units.source_text: 有的人甚至怎么说也不愿洗手不干。

en.t: and some of them refuse to wash their hands of it no matter what anyone says.

units.source_text: ……这么说来，那人从未对我们挑明过一次，

en.t: ...In that case, the fact that the man never once explained it openly to us,

units.source_text: 那态度本身，不也就证明了，

en.t: does that attitude itself not prove

units.source_text: 连他自己也觉得这种兴趣见不得人吗？

en.t: that even he himself felt this interest was something shameful?
